note: Pre-1999 gmina codes (teryt_gmina_pre1999: 2-digit voivodeship of 1975-1998 + 3-digit gmina number of the old GUS register) in the mart, each with the 1999 TERYT code of the same gmina and the current gmina keys of gminy.json/gminy_osm.json that cover it. map_units maps a code with one current key to that key and a code with several to the code itself (a former extent in gminy_osm.json). The voivodeship of an old code is its first two digits (PKW), so 'voivodeships' below is the gmina -> 1975-1998 voivodeship assignment used for wojewodztwa_1975.json (unions of the gminy.json polygons listed).

sources.pkw: Old code, gmina name and 1975-1998 voivodeship of every gmina in the KBW/PKW precinct files of 1990, 1991, 1993, 1995, 1996 and 1997 (mart.precincts, mart.prezydent_precinct_protocols, mart.referendum_precinct_protocols: teryt_gmina_pre1999, gmina, wojewodztwo).
sources.gus_bdl: GUS Bank Danych Lokalnych gmina units of 1995-1998 (mart.gus_units, level 'gmina'): 1999 TERYT code, current name, gmina type and powiat of each gmina that existed in that year.
sources.pkw_1998_2002: Gmina names under 1999 TERYT codes in the PKW files of the 1998 sejmik, 2000 president, 2001 Sejm and 2002 sejmik/mayor elections (names GUS later changed, e.g. Słupsk gm. -> Redzikowo, Brzeg gm. -> Skarbimierz).
sources.gus_komunikat: GUS, Komunikat o zmianach w podziale terytorialnym (volumes 1977-1998, https://statlibr.stat.gov.pl/exlibris/aleph/a22_1/apache_media/NK4GCPC6BDD4UTE745ERLC8CJXEYYP.pdf): renames, gminas created from parts of others, and the 1994 Warsaw reorganisation.
sources.consulted_without_old_codes: Ustawa z dnia 24 lipca 1998 r. (Dz.U. 1998 nr 96 poz. 603, gminas per new voivodeship), Rozporządzenie RM z dnia 7 sierpnia 1998 r. (Dz.U. 1998 nr 103 poz. 652, gminas per powiat), Rozporządzenie RM z dnia 15 grudnia 1998 r. (Dz.U. 1998 nr 157 poz. 1031, 1999 identifiers) and GUS 'Wykaz identyfikatorów i nazw jednostek podziału terytorialnego kraju' list the new units only; GUS TERYT (eTERYT) files start on 1999-01-01. No official key from pre-1999 codes to 1999 TERYT was found.

method: Per election year, each old code was matched to the GUS BDL gmina of that year (1995 for 1990-1993) with the same name (PKW spelling, BDL name or the 1998-2002 PKW name; case, diacritics, 'gm.' and punctuation ignored) and the same type (old numbers 100-499 towns and urban-rural gminas, 500-999 rural gminas, 001-099 Warsaw). A name unique in Poland was accepted; otherwise the match had to be unique within the 1999 powiats that hold the voivodeship's other matches. Every match was checked spatially: the gmina must touch the largest connected group of gminas of the same old voivodeship, else it was dropped (this removed e.g. 'Kostrzyn' of gorzowskie -> Kostrzyn in powiat poznański). Where no type matched, the name alone was accepted if unique in the area or in Poland (town rights granted or lost since). Renamed gminas were matched by their new name (ALIASES, each with the act). A code matched in several years always got the same gmina; no 1999 gmina got two codes in one year, and no current gmina got two voivodeships.

year_notes.1990: The KBW file of the 1990 presidential election uses the gmina list of 1993 (2465 codes, the same as 1993).
year_notes.1991: The 1991 Sejm file reflects the gminas of 1991. 24 rural gminas have no own row; their precincts are under the town of the same name (e.g. Terespol 11 precincts in 1991 = 3 + 8 in 1993): Terespol, Brańsk, Siemiatycze, Działdowo, Płońsk, Raciąż, Kościerzyna, Skórcz, Świdwin, Złotoryja, Kolno, Wysokie Mazowieckie, Jordanów, Limanowa, Mszana Dolna, Lubawa, Gostynin, Łęczyca, Sierpc, Dynów, Radymno, Sławno, Sejny, Radziejów. 22 gminas created between 1991 and 1993 have no row either (Rydułtowy, Wojkowice, Goczałkowice-Zdrój, Jejkowice, Kornowac, Czarna Woda, Polanka Wielka, Bystra-Sidzina, Młynarze, Szulborze Wielkie, Rudka, Gawłuszowice, Słupia Konecka, Smyków, Aleksandrów, Bełżec, Budziszewice, Miasteczko Krajeńskie, Tułowice (opolskie), Boronów, Starcza, Ursus). On 1991 gmina maps these units stay grey and the gmina that held them is drawn in its later extent; five gminas carry a different code in 1991 only (05701 Tykocin, 43677 Piaski, 53633 Korfantów, 55581 Myszyniec, 27245 Leszczyny), matched like the others.

01001.name: Warszawa Mokotów
